definitions.task: Eight tokens, each one of 32 values, are classified into 10 classes by a fixed random teacher (its own embedding table, then two ReLU layers of width 128, then the argmax). Every step draws 256 fresh token strings.
definitions.model: An embedding table (width n), two n × n ReLU hidden matrices and a readout to 10 logits.
definitions.loss: Cross-entropy against the teacher's labels on 8192 fixed held-out token strings after the last step, averaged over seeds. A run that ends at or above ln 10, the loss of a zero output, has failed and counts at ln 10.
definitions.W: The effective weight of a layer, W = A · w: the stored tensor w times its forward multiplier A (A = 1 in SP).
definitions.dW: ΔW = W_T − W_0, the total change of the effective weight over training.
definitions.op_norm: ‖M‖op, the largest singular value of M, from a float64 SVD.
definitions.spectral_normalisation: ‖W‖op and ‖ΔW‖op are divided by √(fan_out/fan_in) (Yang, Simon & Bernstein 2023, arXiv:2310.17813). For the square hidden matrices this factor is 1.
definitions.act_rms: Root mean square of the second hidden layer's activations on 1024 held-out token strings after training.
definitions.ratio: A certificate value divided by the same value at the proxy width, the smallest.
definitions.band: A value passes when its ratio to the proxy lies inside the band.
definitions.transfer: The certificate runs use, at every width, the grid learning rate nearest to the proxy's fitted minimum.
definitions.minimum: Vertex of the parabola through the grid minimum of the mean loss and its two neighbours, in log2 η.
definitions.slope: Least-squares slope of the fitted minima, in octaves of η per octave of width.
definitions.act3: A grouped-query K/V projection with r repeats is the row stack of r copies of one (n/r) × n block (GQA-μP Lemma 1). The block has i.i.d. N(0, 1/n) entries: the hidden-layer rule, which ignores the repetition. act_rms is the RMS of the stacked projection applied to N(0, I) inputs; stacked_op is its largest singular value; the ratios are to r = 1. Nothing here is trained.
